title: Every report row adds up to the report totals to the cent
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on, so that one work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Have, at the test location today, at least three invoices: one split work order (Labor and Parts set to the two staff members), one work order with one person on both sides and one part sale.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today and Show Unassigned on.
custom_steps: 1. Click the chevron in the Date column header to expand every row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every representative's invoice rows show.
  • Adding up by hand every invoice row's Labor Invoiced, Parts Invoiced, Shop Supplies and Hrs Invoiced, each representative's summary row equals the sum of its invoice rows.
  • The report totals equal the sum of all invoice rows.
  • The sums match to the cent (hours to two decimals).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R16: “A representative's summary row always shows real sums, never dashes.”
  • S5-R14: “With Show Unassigned on, the report's totals are the same whether invoices are split or not. With it off, a side credited to Unassigned is left out of the totals, as Unassigned money is today.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, rounding: “Σ rows = totals holds to the cent.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
